description: Use when the user asks what duty rate or commodity code applies to a product imported from China to the UK: finds the UK commodity code and import duty rate from a product description (English or Chinese) or a commodity code. Also flags codes where China-specific anti-dumping or countervailing duty exists.

commodity_code.description: A 6 to 10 digit UK commodity code, if known.

locale.description: Language for names and links: en (default) or zh (Simplified Chinese).

product.description: What is being imported, e.g. 'cotton t-shirts' or 'ceramic tiles'.

name: find_duty_rate
title: Find a UK duty rate
